create.name: Shelly Reef
create.bio:
Shelly Reef is a sound healer, musician and meditation teacher who has taught for over twenty years in more than twenty-five countries. Her main instrument is the harp: she created the Therapy Harp approach, a way of playing a small lap harp for meditation and sound sessions, and trains other practitioners in it through beginner, advanced and certification courses. She also works with crystal bowls, chimes and monochords, and for about fifteen years has taught courses in telepathy and remote viewing as part of her interest in consciousness beyond the senses.

Alongside her own teaching she co-developed AntiGravity Restorative Aerial Yoga, has taught for The Shift Network, and contributed music to the film Frequency: The Secret of Everything. She offers private sound sessions and empathic readings, and her YouTube channel carries long guided sound meditations with harp, bowls and voice as well as shorter teaching clips. A collaborative album with Christine Stevens and a memoir about interdimensional contact are both described on her site as forthcoming.
